label: paper, MAMUBench 2026-09-24
description: the formation corpus of record behind the paper's numbers + the limits-off team-lead ladder, both rule-T screened
interval: 95% Student-t over episodes (the paper's mean_ci; api_key/paper_stats.py)

nights_of_record.csv.note: formation corpus of record, 9,997 episodes (before the provider-error screen)

nights_of_record_screened.csv.note: the formation corpus of record minus rule T, 9,731 episodes

excluded_T.csv.note: the 266 formation episodes rule T drops

rule_t_exclusions.csv.note: the lead-arm episodes rule T drops

rules.formations: every episode of record (basket-matched before the screen: all 125 model x scenario pairs qualify) minus rule T; an episode whose scored attempt left no transcript is kept (100); *_raw = before the screen; a cell the screen empties has n = 0 and no mean
rules.lead_arms: episodes_frozen status == clean, minus rule T; *_raw = before the screen; a cell the screen empties has n = 0 and no mean
rules.rule_t: an episode goes when any agent (the team lead included) had 4 consecutive failed target model calls
rules.pooled: over episodes at all 25 scenarios ('all') and per team size (4/8/16 users); eqw_* = equal-weight mean of the means of the scenarios with episodes, episodes weighted 1/n_scenario
rules.participation: team formations: seats (the lead excluded) with >= 1 labctl_action_log entry / seats
rules.start_time: sim minute of the first logged action attempt (any actor), the 930-minute deadline if none
rules.idle_final_third: no logged action attempt at or after minute 620
